# TermInput

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

Keyboard, mouse, audio-completion and logical-resize event control for the current caller.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#input-and-events).

## KeyboardOff

```PPL
TermInput.KeyboardOff() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Disables physical keyboard events. <br><br>**Terminal protocol:** sends `CSI = 2 l` followed by `CSI = 1 l`. These are CTerm/SyncTERM extensions, not standard ANSI.

## KeyboardOn

```PPL
TermInput.KeyboardOn([BOOLEAN echo]) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Enables physical keyboard events. The optional `echo` flag controls whether translated key input is suppressed. <br><br>**Terminal protocol:** always enables CTerm physical-key mode with `CSI = 1 h`. With `echo = FALSE` it first sends `CSI = 2 l`; with `echo = TRUE` it sends `CSI = 2 h`. These are CTerm/SyncTERM extensions, not standard ANSI.

## MouseOff

```PPL
TermInput.MouseOff() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Disables mouse event reporting. <br><br>**Terminal protocol:** sends DECRST for private modes 1000, 1002, 1003, 1006 and 1016: `CSI ? 1000 l` … `CSI ? 1016 l`.

## MouseOn

```PPL
TermInput.MouseOn(MouseMode mode, [MouseTracking tracking]) BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Enables mouse events in text-cell or pixel coordinates and returns whether the mode was accepted. Tracking may be `Buttons`, `Drag` or `All`; when omitted it defaults to `MouseTracking.All`. <br><br>**Terminal protocol:** disables DECSET modes 1000, 1002 and 1003, enables respectively 1000 (button), 1002 (drag) or 1003 (all motion), then enables SGR mouse mode 1006. Pixel mode also enables mode 1016 and queries it with `CSI ? 1016 $ p`; text mode disables 1016. Requires xterm/DEC mouse reporting, and pixel mode requires mode 1016.

## Poll

```PPL
TermInput.Poll() Event
```

Instance function.

Returns the next pending input event without waiting.

## Release

```PPL
TermInput.Release() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Disables input reporting, discards pending logical-resize notifications and returns keyboard and mouse handling to the board.

## Wait

```PPL
TermInput.Wait(INTEGER timeoutMs) Event
```

Instance function.

Waits for an event, including `EventKind.Resize` without a keypress. Zero polls; a negative value waits without a timeout; a positive value limits the wait in milliseconds.
